steps: Arrange 20 rice crackers, plain on a plate.
Place 1 stick (28g) string cheese alongside.
Peel and segment 1 medium orange.
Arrange orange segments with 10 whole almonds on a plate or in a bowl.
Pour 15 banana chips, unsweetened into a bowl or small container.
Serve immediately.
Peel 1 medium banana, slightly under-ripe.
Eat whole or slice to serve.
Place 40 g dried pineapple, unsweetened in a bowl or bag for portability.
Serve as is.
Retrieve 1 large hard-boiled egg from the refrigerator.
Peel and eat plain.
Cut 30 g Swiss or Parmesan cheese into cubes or slice thinly.
Arrange on a plate or in a container.
Pour 350 ml lactose-free chocolate milk into a glass or bottle.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Spoon 170 g lactose-free yoghurt into a bowl.
Slice 1 kiwi fruit and arrange on top.
Arrange 6 gluten-free rice crackers on a plate.
Top each with a thin slice of 20 g cheddar cheese.
Spread 1 tsp marmalade over the cheese.
Pour 40 g sweet potato chips, baked with olive oil into a bowl or bag.
Serve immediately.
Cut 150 g carrot and cucumber sticks into snack-size pieces.
Measure 1.5 tbsp peanut butter into a small bowl as a dip.
Cook 1/2 cup certified gluten-free oats in water or milk for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Slice 1/2 unripe banana and stir into the warm oats.
Top with 1 tbsp peanut butter and pour 100 ml lactose-free milk around or over the bowl.
Remove 1 bar (40g) low-FODMAP certified granola bar (e.g., Fody) from packaging.
Eat as a snack.
Remove 1 bar Bobo's oat bar, peanut butter flavour from packaging.
Eat as a snack.
Slice 1 medium pear in half or into wedges.
Measure 1.5 tbsp almond butter into a small bowl for dipping.
Rinse and place 150 g grapes in a bowl or container.
Serve chilled.
Measure 40 g raisins into a bowl or small bag for portability.
Serve as is.
Halve 1 small sweet potato lengthwise if not already halved.
Spread 1 tbsp almond butter over the warm or room-temperature sweet potato.
Cook 1/2 cup certified gluten-free oats in water or milk for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Top with 80 g mixed berries, 1 tbsp chopped walnuts, and 1 tsp chia seeds.
Spoon 170 g cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 100 g mixed berries.
Measure 30 g mixed nuts, unsalted into a bowl or bag.
Serve as a snack.
Spoon 170 g Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Slice 1/2 banana and arrange on top.
Sprinkle 1 tbsp sliced almonds over the bowl.
Spoon 170 g plain yogurt into a bowl.
Stir in 20 g mixed nuts, chopped until evenly distributed.
Place 150 g cold cooked quinoa in a bowl.
Stir in 2 tbsp dried cranberries.
Remove 1 bar gluten-free protein bar (e.g., Clif, Think!, KIND) from packaging.
Eat as a snack.
Arrange 2 certified gluten-free oat biscuits (e.g., Nairn's Oaties) on a plate.
Serve plain or as a base for toppings.
Remove 1 bar gluten-free high-carb sports bar (e.g., Styrkr BAR50) from packaging.
Eat as a snack.
Pour 40 g organic corn tortilla chips into a bowl.
Top or serve alongside 3 tbsp salsa.
Arrange 30 g gluten-free pretzels and 80 g carrot sticks on a plate.
Measure 1 tbsp almond butter into a small bowl for dipping.
Cut 150 g jicama into thin strips.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp lime juice and sprinkle with a pinch of cayenne pepper.
Lay out 100 g sliced turkey breast.
Spread 2 tbsp cream cheese across the slices and roll tightly.
Lay out 3 large lettuce leaves on a plate.
Layer 100 g sliced turkey breast and 30 g sliced cheddar on each leaf.
Roll up tightly.
Mash 85 g canned tuna in water with a small amount of mayo.
Arrange 8 gluten-free crackers on a plate and top each with a spoonful of tuna salad.
Place 30 g kale chips, baked with olive oil and salt in a bowl.
Serve immediately.
Arrange 30 g beef jerky, plain and 20 g kale chips, baked on a plate together.
Serve as a snack combo.
Mix 20 g puffed rice, 1 tbsp sesame seeds, and 15 g chopped hazelnuts in a bowl.
Fold in 20 g dried apricots and 1 tbsp tahini until combined.
Press into squares or balls and refrigerate until firm.
Toss 20 g pumpkin seeds, 15 g sunflower seeds, and 20 g quinoa flakes on a baking sheet.
Toast in a 175°C oven for 5-7 minutes until fragrant.
Mix in 20 g dried blueberries and 15 g dried cranberries, and let cool before serving.
Mix 40 g certified gluten-free oats, 1 tbsp honey, and 1 tbsp shredded coconut in a bowl.
Form into small balls with damp hands.
Chill until firm.
Slice 1/2 banana into a bowl or plate.
Pit and arrange 2-3 Medjool dates alongside.
Blend 1 frozen banana, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tsp cocoa powder, and 250 ml milk until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
Arrange 30 g beef jerky, plain and 30 g raw cheddar cheese on a plate together.
Serve as a snack combo.
Peel 2 hard-boiled eggs and slice or halve them.
Slice 1/2 avocado alongside and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.
Measure 30 g mixed nuts, unsalted into a bowl.
Add 10 green or Kalamata olives and serve together.
Measure 30 g roasted sunflower seeds into a bowl.
Add 10 Kalamata olives and serve together.
Slice 1/2 avocado and arrange on a plate.
Top with 2 tbsp roasted pumpkin seeds and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.
Cut 40 g cheddar cheese into cubes.
Arrange cheese cubes with 20 g walnuts on a plate.
Spoon 3 tbsp full-fat sour cream into a bowl.
Top with 60 g fresh raspberries.
Slice 1/2 avocado and arrange on a plate.
Place 6 macadamia nuts alongside and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.
Pour 12 Kalamata olives into a bowl or onto a plate.
Cube 30 g sharp cheddar and arrange alongside or mixed together.
Arrange 60 g cold-smoked salmon on a plate.
Slice 1/2 cucumber and arrange alongside.
Warm 60 g fresh spinach in a skillet with 1 tsp olive oil over medium heat until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Halve 2 hard-boiled eggs and arrange on a plate with the sautéed spinach.
Cut 150 g cantaloupe or honeydew melon into slices or cubes.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Place 100 g mixed berries in a bowl.
Serve fresh or chilled.
Place 150 g roasted brussels sprouts on a plate and drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Chop 1 hard-boiled egg and dice 60 g cooked chicken and 1/4 avocado into a bowl.
Top with 15 g crumbled cheddar and toss gently to combine.
Wrap 2 cooked bacon slices around 1/2 avocado wedges, dividing the bacon between multiple wedges.
Secure with toothpicks if needed and serve warm or at room temperature.
Measure 20 g unsweetened coconut flakes and 20 g macadamia nuts into a bowl.
Serve as a snack mix.
Warm 80 g ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes, breaking it into small pieces.
Place a handful of spinach leaves on each of 2 lettuce wraps and top with the cooked beef.
Cut 100 g carrot into sticks.
Serve with 60 g guacamole (avocado, lime, salt) as a dip.
Arrange 150 g cold blanched asparagus spears on a plate.
Drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.
Arrange 120 g cold steamed broccoli florets on a plate.
Top with 20 g shredded cheddar.
Heat 350 ml bone broth in a mug or bowl to steaming.
Stir in 80 g shredded chicken and a handful of fresh spinach until the spinach wilts, about 1 minute.
Slice 90 g tri-tip steak, cooked cold into a plate.
Serve at room temperature.
Whip 2 tbsp heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Top 100 g mixed berries with the whipped cream.
Wrap 3 slices prosciutto around 120 g cantaloupe wedges, dividing the prosciutto between multiple pieces.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Peel and separate 2 small mandarin oranges into segments.
Serve fresh.
Place 1 boiled egg (already cooked) on a plate.
Peel and eat plain.
Air-pop 3 cups popcorn in a popcorn maker or over stovetop heat.
Transfer to a bowl and serve plain.
Arrange 4 plain rice biscuits on a plate.
Serve plain or as a base.
Measure 30 g roasted pumpkin seeds and 20 g roasted sunflower seeds into a bowl.
Serve as a snack mix.
Spread 1.5 tbsp sunflower seed butter onto 2 plain rice cakes.
Serve immediately.
Spoon 150 g coconut or soy yoghurt, unsweetened into a bowl.
Slice and top with 100 g fresh strawberries.
Top 2 plain rice cakes with 85 g canned tuna in water, drained.
Serve as is.
Pour 120 g roasted chickpeas into a bowl.
Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp cumin and toss to coat.
Top 3 gluten-free oatcakes with 20 g sliced cheddar.
Serve immediately.
Slice 150 g cucumber and arrange in a bowl.
Serve with 60 g hummus as a dip.
Remove 1 gluten-free stroopwafel from packaging and serve.
Eat immediately.
Top 8 salted rice crackers with mashed 1/2 avocado.
Serve immediately.
Place 6 dried apricots in a bowl or bag.
Serve as a snack.
Place 150 g cold cooked white rice in a bowl.
Serve at room temperature.
Place 150 g cold boiled mashed sweet potato in a bowl.
Serve at room temperature.
Open 1 pouch (30g) gluten-free fruit snacks or gummy candy.
Eat immediately.
Air-pop 3 cups popcorn in a popcorn maker or over stovetop heat.
Lightly spray with olive oil spray and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Arrange 30 g gluten-free pita chips on a plate.
Serve with 60 g roasted red pepper hummus as a dip.
Spoon 170 g cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 100 g sliced cucumber.
Slice 90 g cold roasted chicken breast and arrange on a plate.
Serve chilled.
Place 30 g beef jerky, plain, no soy sauce in a bowl or bag.
Serve as a portable snack.
Toast 1 slice gluten-free bread until golden.
Spread with 1.5 tbsp sunflower seed butter.
Top with sliced 1/2 banana.
Pour 30 g roasted, salted pumpkin seeds into a bowl or bag.
Serve as a snack.
Open 1 pouch (113g) unsweetened applesauce.
Squeeze into a bowl or eat directly from the pouch.
Mix 30 g certified gluten-free oats, 1/2 mashed banana, and 1 tsp honey in a bowl until sticky.
Form into small bites with damp hands and chill until firm.
Whisk 3 tbsp chia seeds into 200 ml coconut milk in a bowl or jar.
Stir in 1 tsp maple syrup.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until thick and pudding-like.
Top 2 plain rice cakes with mashed 1/2 avocado.
Drizzle with 1 tsp lime juice.
Form 120 g cooked white rice into a triangle shape by hand or using a mold.
Insert 1 whole umeboshi (pickled plum) into the center.
Wrap nori (seaweed sheet) strip around the rice ball.
Remove 1 sweet potato bread bun (konbini) from packaging.
Eat as-is or warm gently if desired.
Open or purchase 1 red bean paste bread roll and 1 small baguette sandwich (ham or egg) from a convenience store.
Serve both together.
Remove 1 bread roll filled with chocolate pudding from packaging.
Eat immediately.
Open 1 small pack of Hi-Chew fruit chews.
Eat immediately.
Open 1 packet azuki (red bean) paste.
Eat directly or squeeze into a bowl.
Take 1 orange-flavored sweet bun from the hotel buffet or remove from packaging.
Eat immediately.
Bring 1 cup clear broth to a boil in a small pot or mug.
Add 2 pieces mochi (rice cake) and simmer for 2 minutes until soft.
Serve in the broth.
Brew 1 cup (250 ml) chai by boiling black tea with milk and sugar for 2-3 minutes.
Serve warm with 1 piece mandazi (fried Swahili bread) on the side.
Brew 1 cup (250 ml) chai by boiling black tea with milk and sugar for 2-3 minutes.
Spread 1 tsp margarine on each of 2 slices white bread.
Serve bread alongside the hot chai.
Brew 1 cup (250 ml) chai by boiling black tea with milk and sugar for 2-3 minutes.
Spread 1 tbsp jam on 2 slices white bread.
Serve bread alongside the hot chai.
Brew 1 cup (250 ml) chai by boiling black tea with milk and sugar for 2-3 minutes.
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter on 2 slices white bread.
Serve bread alongside the hot chai.
Brew 1 cup (250 ml) chai by boiling black tea with milk and sugar for 2-3 minutes.
Warm 1 piece chapati if needed and serve alongside the hot chai.
Brew 1 cup (250 ml) black tea with boiled milk and sugar for 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot in a cup.
Chew 1 sugarcane stick raw.
Extract and swallow the sweet juice.
Boil 1 medium (150 g) sweet potato in water for 15-20 minutes until fork-tender.
Drain and serve warm or at room temperature.
Boil 1 medium green banana in water for 12-15 minutes until tender.
Drain and peel, then serve warm or at room temperature.
Cut 250 g watermelon into cubes or slices.
Place in a bowl and serve chilled.
Peel 1 medium ripe banana.
Eat whole or slice into a bowl.
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter onto 1 piece chapati.
Serve immediately or wrap for portability.
Cut cooked rice square (70 g) in half or into bite-sized pieces.
Top with mashed 1/2 banana, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 1 tsp cacao nibs.
Cut cooked rice square (70 g) in half or into bite-sized pieces.
Top with 2 tbsp blueberries and 1 tbsp chopped dark chocolate (72%+).
Cut cooked rice square (70 g) in half or into bite-sized pieces.
Top with 1 slice crumbled cooked bacon and drizzle with 1 tsp maple syrup.
Cut cooked rice square (70 g) in half or into bite-sized pieces.
Top with 1 tbsp dried cranberries, 1/2 tsp orange zest, and 1 tbsp chopped white chocolate.
Cut cooked rice square (70 g) in half or into bite-sized pieces.
Top with 1 tbsp dried tart cherries and 1/2 tsp lemon zest.
Spread 1 tbsp jam on one slice of soft white crustless bread and 1 tbsp cream cheese on the other.
Press together to form a sandwich.
Cut into halves or triangles if desired.
